entities.name: Abel Gabuza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abel Gabuza was a South African Catholic prelate who served as Coadjutor Archbishop of Durban from 9 December 2018 and until his death in 2021. He was Bishop of Kimberley from 2010 to 2018.
